video_url.description: URL of the video to upscale
video_url.title: Video Url

target_fps.description: Target FPS for the output. Frame interpolation is enabled only when this differs from the source FPS.
target_fps.title: Target Fps

upscale_factor.description: Factor to upscale the video by (e.g. 2.0 doubles width and height)
upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor

model.description: Precision (non-generative) enhancement model. Proteus fits most real-world footage; Proteus Natural is a softer variant; Iris recovers faces; Dione deinterlaces legacy/interlaced sources; Artemis denoises and sharpens degraded footage; Gaia refines high-quality footage and CG (Gaia 2 upscales animation at 2x); Rhea maximizes fine detail via an internal 4x pass; Theia gives manual detail/fidelity control.
model.title: Model

noise.description: Noise reduction level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.
noise.title: Noise

grain.description: Film grain amount (0.0-0.1). Default varies by model.
grain.title: Grain

H264_output.description: Whether to use H264 codec for output video. Default is H265.
H264_output.title: H264 Output

compression.description: Compression artifact removal level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.
compression.title: Compression

recover_detail.description: Recover original detail level (0.0-1.0). Higher values preserve more original detail.
recover_detail.title: Recover Detail

halo.description: Halo reduction level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.
halo.title: Halo

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url
